subsection.title: Graphs of sine and cosine
subsection.p: The unit circle produces the graphs of sine and cosine as the angle changes.
Both functions have period 2\pi. The sine graph starts at 0, rises to 1, returns to 0, falls to -1, and returns to 0.
The cosine graph starts at 1, falls to 0, reaches -1, returns to 0, and then returns to 1.

figure.caption: Sine and cosine are periodic because the unit circle repeats after a full turn.
